title: S3-SW-14 SPACE WEATHER CENTRE FOR SPAIN INITIAL ESTABLISHMENT AND CORE CAPABILITY DEVELOPMENTS: PART 1
description: Space Weather Centre for Spain Initial Establishment and Core Capability Developments: Part 1This activity will constitute the initial establishment and operation of a Space Weather Centre for affected stakeholders along with underpinning tools, capabilities and procedures required in order to deliver tailored high quality services to end users. Key user groups are expected to include operators of energy transmission systems, satellite operators, the aviation sector, the Ministry of Defence (MoD) and others. The Centre shall operate in close cooperation with ESA's Space weather Service Network with the aim to establish a node that facilitates collaborative actions with network participants while moving progressively towards a structure with a clear operational dimension ableto support the development and delivery of tailored space weather capabilities and services. Particularly the centre will focus on translating complex space weather information from multiple sources into streamlined, actionable information. A colocation of the development and operations teams shall be foreseen with the aim to streamline the R2O process, support team building and to encouragedirect feedback to research, optimising the use of facilities in ESAC.Part 1 shall include: Systematic mapping of end users and establishment of key contact points with users and stakeholders Establishment of a proactive engagement strategy and actions with the identified end users to ensure full understanding of end user needs and operational requirements Development of necessary IT infrastructure, tools and service operation procedures in order to operate the space weather front desk, initially on an 8/5 basis, with on-call support during periods of elevated space weather activity. OoProcedures shall be developed with a view to transitioning into full 24/7 support at the start of a future Part 2 of this activity. Operation of the space weather front desk from KO+3 months for at least 6 months prior to the start of Part 2 handover Development of a space weather dashboard capabilities targeting end users and building on well demonstrated and tested space weather assets, constituting a layer for translating complex technical concepts into an easy-to-use tool for end users. Training for end users including exercises and simulations based on realistic use casesDevelopment of a roadmap for the operational Centre including priority R2O needs and the inclusion of a space weather testbed facility to be used for regional event simulations and training, bringing together stakeholders including end users, operators and domain experts with a focus on optimising the R2O2R pipeline. Support for data and product provision from existing assetsas part of the service provision shall be foreseen where it does not duplicate activities already funded via the Space Safety Programme's pre operational space weather service activities. Operationalisation of certain key models and tools along with their re-deployment within the Centre may be foreseen subject to the necessary licensing agreements with the asset owner. A handover to Part 2of the activity shall be foreseen.

title: Steag UE și RO, prevăzute cu catarg telescopic,
description: IGSU intenționeaza sa achizitioneze 1 set - Steag UE și RO, prevăzute cu catarg telescopic, în cadrul proiectului Grant de adaptare modul GFFF-V-RO astfel cum este descris in Specificația Tehnică nr. 48468/02.09.2022. TERMEN MAXIM DE LIVRARE: 2 luni de la semnarea angajamentului legal (comandă). Livrarea se va efectua conform termenilor comerciali de livrare și vor fi interpretaţi conform regulilor INCOTERMS 2020 aplicabile (și orice versiuni ulterioare a INCOTERMS, dacă este cazul), condiţia de livrare DDP la o locație stabilită de comun acord de către furnizor și achizitor, de pe teritoriul României. Plata facturii se va efectua cu ordin de plată în lei prin trezorerie, în termen de maxim 30 de zile de la recepție. În acest sens, operatorul economic declarat câștigător trebuie să dețină cont în trezorerie. ATENȚIE! 1) Oferta va fi elaborata sub forma unui TABEL COMPARATIV, astfel incat autoritatea contractanta sa identifice cu usurinta reperele ofertate, conform specificației tehnice atasate (denumire produs, unitate de masura, cantitate). In acest sens se va mentiona descrierea detaliata a produselor (denumire produs, denumire producator, garantie, caracteristici tehnice etc.). 2) Oferta va avea valabilitate de cel puțin 30 de zile și va cuprinde detalii privind accesarea acesteia in SEAP - catalog electronic. Oferta totală va fi exprimată în LEI fără TVA, cu două zecimale. Prețul cel mai scăzut / ofertă în conformitate cu art. 187 alin (3) lit a) din Legea nr. 98/2016 privind achizițiile publice. Având în vedere criteriul de atribuire aplicat, responsabilii de procedură au posibilitatea de a analiza doar oferta cu prețul cel mai mic ofertat, iar în cazul în care aceasta corespunde necesitaților autoritatii contractante, atribuirea se face fără a mai analiza celelalte oferte. Pe cale de consecință, în cazul în care oferta cu prețul cel mai scăzut nu îndeplinește cerințele autorității contractante, responsabilii de procedura vor proceda la analizarea ofertei care are prețul imediat următor (din punct de vedere crescător).Ofertele care nu vor fi analizate ca urmare a declarării câștigătoare a unei oferte cu preț mai mic, vor fi declarate "oferte participante". Oferta care este declarată câştigătoare conform criteriului de atribuire stabilit trebuie să îndeplinească toate cerințele minime obligatorii astfel cum au fost stabilite prin Specifiatia tehnică. OFERTA: În cazul unor oferte care vor prezenta acelaşi preţ, departajarea se va face prin reofertarea propunerii financiare. Se transmite pe adresa de email: gabriel.vlase@igsu.ro până la data limită de depunere a ofertelor. ATENȚIE!!! Comunicarea privind rezultatul achiziției se va face doar ofertantului câștigător. Cerintele tehnice definite la nivelul anuntului de publicitate, caietului de sarcini sau altor documente complementare, prin trimiterea standardelor, la un anumit producator, la marci, brevete, tipuri, la o origine sau la o productie/metoda specifica de fabricatie/prestare/executie, vor fi intelese ca fiind insotite de mentiunea ”sau echivalent”.

title: Finland – Miscellaneous cleaning machines – Siivouskoneet ja tekstiilienkäsittelylaitteet
description: Numera yhteishankintapalvelut (Numera Palvelut Oy) pyytää tarjoustanne ammattimaiseen käyttöön soveltuvista siivouskoneista ja tekstiilienkäsittelylaitteista tarjouspyyntöasiakirjojen mukaan. Lisäksi hankinta sisältää optiona leasing-rahoituksella hankittavat siivouskoneet ja tekstiilienkäsittelylaitteet sekä takuuajan jälkeiset huoltopalvelut ja pyykinpesukoneiden ja kuivausrumpujen asennuspalvelu. Hankinta sisältää erilaiset ostettavat lattianhoitokoneet, yhdistelmäkoneet, imurit, laitoskäyttöön tarkoitetut pyykinpesukoneet ja kuivausrummut. Myös robottisiivouskoneita voi hankkia kilpailutuksen myötä syntyvällä sopimuksella. Hankinta on jaettu osakokonaisuuksiin seuraavasti: Osakokonaisuus 1: Siivouskoneet ja tekstiilienkäsittelylaitteet / Uusimaa Osakokonaisuus 2: Siivouskoneet ja tekstiilienkäsittelylaitteet / Muu Suomi Kilpailutus suoritetaan avoimella menettelyllä, jonka perusteella puitejärjestelyyn valitaan enintään kolme (3) eniten pisteitä saanutta sopimustoimittajaa osakokonaisuuksittain. Tarjoaja voi antaa tarjouksen joko yhteen tai kumpaankin osakokonaisuuteen. Kilpailutuksen valintaperusteena on kokonaistaloudellinen edullisuus hinnan painoarvon ollessa 80 % ja laadun painoarvon ollessa 20 %. Sopimuskausi on määräaikainen neljä (4) vuotta. Sopimuskausi alkaa aikaisintaan hankintapäätöksen saatua lainvoiman tai markkinaoikeuden annettua sopimukselle täytäntöönpanoluvan. Sopimuksen irtisanomisaika on molempien sopijapuolten ja hankintaan sitoutuneiden Numera Palvelut Oy:n asiakasyhteisöjen osalta kuusi (6) kuukautta määräaikaisuudesta huolimatta. Tavoitteena on, että sopimuskausi alkaa 1.1.2027 (arvio). Sopimukseen liittyvät yhteisöt siirtyvät tehtävän sopimuksen piiriin nykyisten sopimustensa päättymisen jälkeen. Osatarjouksia ei hyväksytä. Rinnakkaisia tarjouksia ei hyväksytä. Tarjoaja sitoutuu tarjouksellaan kaikkiin tarjouspyynnössä esitettyihin ehtoihin. Hankintayksiköllä on oikeus tarkistaa tarjoajan tarjousasiakirjoissa antamat tiedot ennen hankintapäätöksen tekemistä. Mikäli annetut tiedot eivät pidä paikkansa, tarjous hylätään. HUOM! Tarjouspalvelun käyttöön liittyvissä ongelmissa tarjoajan tulee olla yhteydessä Cloudia-tukeen yhteydenottolomakkeella tai numeroon 020 766 1075. Numera Palvelut Oy ei vastaa Tarjouspalvelu.fi -toimittajaportaalista.
